description: Same observation, network backbone, game budget and curriculum mechanism; compare complete A2C and DQN methods.
reference_role_alphazero: descriptive playing-strength reference; search and warm-start budgets differ

environment.reward: terminal outcome relative to learner for external opponents; mover-relative reward for alternating self-play

opponents.history_policy: frozen A2C masked argmax with probability 0.05 uniform legal exploration
opponents.external_learner_color: alternate by globally assigned episode id
opponents.comparability_limit: Realized opponent ratios and historical policies may differ from DQN despite using the same curriculum mechanism.

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: mean validation Greedy score across colors; earliest checkpoint wins ties
evaluation.interval: 95% Wilson for each per-seed win rate
evaluation.across_seeds: mean, sample standard deviation, and paired per-seed A2C-minus-DQN differences

checkpointing.barrier: limit new episode allocation to the next 250-game boundary; drain environments and update pending rollout before saving
checkpointing.resume: restore last complete barrier checkpoint; discard unsaved partial progress

scheduling.proposal: Independent A2C three-seed queue completed; original local_suite plan and services were not modified.

runtime_estimate.reason: 1.4M parameters fit the local GPU; compact GPU sampling throughput was similar and backbone capacity matching is useful.

first_formal_run_observation.note: Early-run projection; later game length, opponent mix and load can differ.

completed_run_observation.note: Sum of per-seed active timers; excludes interrupted downtime, and the additional 400-game integrity replay. Wall values include each run initialization/saving, not a continuous elapsed total.

network_alternatives.name: compact_fc64
network_alternatives.role: lighter practical alternative; not approximately capacity matched to existing DQN4
